Now I have the context I need. Let me implement the domain model, validation, and ID helpers.
## DATA-1 — Validated Case Domain Records

### Files created

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `src/domain/model.ts` | Zod schemas, inferred TypeScript types, constants, canonical `buildPairKey`, default viewport |
| `src/domain/validation.ts` | Parse/validate boundaries, `DomainValidationError`, graph rules, tag normalization, format guards |
| `src/domain/ids.ts` | `crypto.randomUUID` IDs, injectable clocks, deterministic test ID factory |
| `tests/domain/model.test.ts` | Schema boundary tests for all six record shapes |
| `tests/domain/validation.test.ts` | Cross-field, pair-key, eligibility, endpoint, tag, ID, and clock tests |

No existing source files were changed. `docs/artifacts/` was not modified or committed.

### Invariants and failure modes covered

- **CaseRecord:** title 1–80 after trim, 80 accepted / 81 rejected; empty and whitespace-only rejected. Subject trimmed, non-empty, max 80. Exam date is a real ISO calendar date (`2026-02-30` and datetime strings rejected). Timestamps require an ISO 8601 timezone and `Date` objects are rejected. `updatedAt` before `createdAt` rejected. `isDemo` defaults to `false`; `backupPromptedAt` and `closedAt` are nullable and round-trip. Unknown fields rejected at case and nested viewport levels.
- **CardRecord:** `note` / `source` / `topic` only; title boundaries; nonnegative finite positions; 10-tag maximum, 24-character maximum, empty and case-insensitive duplicate tags rejected; unknown fields and malformed nested positions rejected. Optional OCR metadata validates when present, and a card without OCR validates.
- **ConnectionRecord:** `association` / `provenance` only; `A::B === B::A`; reversed endpoints with the same canonical key parse; mismatched keys, self-links, malformed keys, and unknown fields rejected.
- **AttachmentRecord:** original/display/thumbnail kinds; JPEG/PNG/WebP MIME only; positive integer dimensions; lowercase 64-char SHA-256; Blob required; `bytes` must equal `blob.size`; unknown fields rejected.
- **Viewport:** inclusive `0.25`–`2.5` scale, negative pan offsets allowed, NaN/Infinity rejected.
- **CaseSummary:** nonnegative integer card and connection counts, required counts, defaults, malformed metadata rejected.
- **Graph rules:** provenance is eligible only between one note and one source in either orientation; association requires two distinct cards; endpoints must exist in the connection's case; dangling, cross-case, self-link, and stale-pair-key candidates are rejected before any write.
- **Tags:** trim, case-insensitive dedupe preserving first display casing and order, empty/overlong/eleventh tag rejected.
- **IDs/time:** generated IDs validate as UUIDs; fixed and system clocks produce ISO timestamp strings; invalid fixed clocks and exhausted sequences throw.

assertCanonicalPairKey(pairKey, a, b): void

handoff.summary: Implemented DATA-1 validated domain records: strict Zod schemas and types for case, card, connection, attachment, viewport, and case summary; canonical unordered pair keys; connection eligibility and endpoint rules; tag normalization; UUID and injectable-clock helpers. Added 78 boundary tests; required tests, typecheck, lint, and the full suite pass.
decisions: Schemas live in src/domain/model.ts with strict unknown-field rejection; parse/validate wrappers and cross-record graph rules live in src/domain/validation.ts.
Exam dates are date-only ISO strings while createdAt, updatedAt, closedAt, backupPromptedAt, and OCR timestamps are full ISO 8601 datetimes.
Tags reject case-insensitive duplicates in the schema, while normalizeTags trims and dedupes preserving the first display casing for UI input.
Added optional flat OCR metadata fields so DATA-2 can preserve them while keeping cards without OCR valid.
